title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
premise: An orphan raised by a cruel aunt and a harsh charity school, Jane becomes governess at Thornfield Hall and grows close to its brooding master, Mr. Rochester.

moments.title: The red-room
moments.happened: As punishment, young Jane is locked in the room where her uncle died, and faints in terror.
alternatives: Mrs. Reed relents and keeps her
Jane is sent to other relatives

moments.title: Fever at Lowood
moments.happened: Typhus sweeps the school, and Jane’s dearest friend Helen dies in her arms.
alternatives: Jane and Helen leave Lowood together

moments.title: A horse on the ice
moments.happened: On a frozen lane a rider’s horse slips. Jane helps him, not knowing he is her master.

moments.title: Fire in the night
moments.happened: Jane wakes to find Rochester’s bed curtains on fire and saves his life.
alternatives: Rochester tells her the truth that night

moments.title: The orchard proposal
moments.happened: Under the chestnut tree Rochester asks Jane to marry him, and she says yes.

moments.title: The interrupted wedding
moments.happened: At the altar a lawyer reveals that Rochester is already married to Bertha, who is hidden in the attic.
alternatives: Rochester and Jane run away together

moments.title: St. John’s proposal
moments.happened: Her cousin St. John asks Jane to marry him and join his mission in India.
alternatives: Jane never hears Rochester’s voice call

moments.title: Return to Thornfield
moments.happened: Jane returns to find Thornfield a burned ruin, and learns where Rochester has gone.
